name: n1-brass-anchor-inside
eval: (async()=>{const g=window.__game,c=g.ctx;const r=c.state.communities.portage.rafts.get('anchor');const V=c.player.position.constructor;const up=c.player.update.bind(c.player);let hold=null;c.player.update=(dt)=>{up(dt);if(hold){c.player.position.copy(hold);c.player.velocity.set(0,0,0);c.player.mode='foot';}};for(let i=0;i<40;i++){const p=new V(1.5,1.0,2.6).applyMatrix4(r.root.matrixWorld);hold=p;c.player.teleport(p);c.player.yaw=r.root.rotation.y+0.12;c.player.pitch=-0.05;g.step(1);await new Promise(q=>setTimeout(q,0));}})()
